short.text: Will Rackley won Jacksonville's right-guard job in camp in 2013 and held it in every game, all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games and both playoff games. His communication on combination blocks won him the job because it held late in practice, and he brought functional strength inside. Individual leverage and recovery after losing it were his main limitations.

transactions.text: Signed a four-year rookie contract with Jacksonville
Traded by Jacksonville to Seattle for Seattle's 2015 seventh-round pick
